title: Evaluation of Environmental impacts of a perovskite solar cell with a p-i-n meso-superstructured architecture through life cycle assessment
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01571A, Paper
Camilo Andrés Valderrama, Juan Felipe Montoya, Aida Luz Villa Holguin, Diana Catalina Rodriguez Loaiza, Francisco Jose Molina, Jaume-Adrià Alberola-Borràs
This study analyzes the environmental impacts of a 1 cm² perovskite solar cell (PSC) with a meso-superstructured p-i-n configuration, fabricated in Colombia. Using life cycle assessment (LCA), we evaluated impacts...
